confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors rest on aggregated cost-of-living snapshots with wide ranges. Drink anchors come from hotel and bar price ranges that conflict across sources, so beer, cocktail and wine are the weakest. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. Omani rial prices were converted at the USD peg. The FX figure was reported in a third-party listing citing RBA 18 Nov 2026. The rba.gov.au overview page appeared in search results but was not opened, so verify the value on the official RBA page before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) basis: Muscat's restaurant and hotel prices are set against regional Gulf cities, with a lower overall level than Dubai. Drink prices are benchmarked to hotel and bar price ranges in Muscat districts such as Qurum and Al Khuwair.
